diff --git a/src/features/agenda.js b/src/features/agenda.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..d76870a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/features/agenda.js
@@ -0,0 +1,8 @@
+import { createEventCard } from './event-card.js';
+
+export function buildAgenda(events) {
+  return events
+    .map((event, index) => ({ card: createEventCard(event), time: new Date(event.startsAt).getTime(), index }))
+    .sort((a, b) => a.time - b.time || a.index - b.index)
+    .map(({ card }) => card);
+}
